headline: JSW One Platforms narrows FY26 net loss by 51% to Rs 107 Cr with 45% revenue growth
hook: Loss narrows as revenue surges at JSW One
summary: JSW Group's B2B ecommerce marketplace JSW One Platforms reported a consolidated net loss of ₹106.5 Cr for FY26, narrowing 50.9% compared to the previous fiscal year. During the same period, the company's revenue jumped 45% as it prepares for an initial public offering. Indian retail investors tracking the JSW group portfolio and upcoming tech-backed listings can assess the platform's improving financial trajectory ahead of its public debut.
whats_next: JSW One IPO filings and further financial updates
why_it_matters: Improves financial viability ahead of JSW One's upcoming public listing.

headline: Motilal Oswal initiates Buy rating on JSW Steel
hook: Brokerage sets 1340 target for JSW Steel
summary: Motilal Oswal has issued a Buy rating on JSW Steel with a target price of Rs 1,340. The brokerage's outlook reflects their assessment of the company's future performance and market position. This target price serves as a reference point for investors tracking analyst sentiment on the steel major.
why_it_matters: Analyst target price updates influence short-term institutional buying sentiment.
